name: 61462 · Monmouth, IL
findings: ZIP 61462 (Monmouth) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 30 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 61462 (Monmouth) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
70% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
